subject: MedEx Labs — follow-up: SOC2 status & SIG-Lite prefill request
messages_raw:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@medexlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — SOC2 status & SIG-Lite prefill request

Hi Karen — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get security moving on our side: 

- Recap: you and Daniel walked through your planned integration (inference calls from MedEx customer portal to Redwood hosted endpoints), expected volumes (test -> pilot -> prod), and the main compliance constraints (HIPAA BAA, US-only residency for PHI).
- Current asks from Redwood Security to scope the right questionnaire: confirmation of SOC 2 posture, whether you prefer SIG-Lite vs CAIQ, and any existing artifacts you can share to accelerate prefill.

Would you confirm the following details when you have a moment?
1) SOC 2 status (Type I/II, and date or target date)
2) Is MedEx a HIPAA-covered entity / will we need a BAA?
3) Data residency (any EU/APAC requirements?)
4) Preferred questionnaire: SIG-Lite, CAIQ, or your custom form?

I attached a short prefill we usually send to customers to speed SIG-Lite kickoff. If you prefer, Monica (cc'd) can take the prefill and do an initial mapping against your SOC2 report to narrow the evidence list.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Prefill.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 42KB)]

Next steps proposed:
- Karen confirms the 4 bullets above by EOD Tue 3/16
- If SIG-Lite is fine, Monica will start prefill and share a tracker for uploads
- Internal: Rishi to set a short SLA for evidence collection (we usually expect 7–10 business days for initial artifacts)

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up if that makes it easier.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

> Hi Michael — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications below: 
>
> - SOC 2: we completed a SOC 2 Type I in Nov 2026; Type II is in progress with target completion Oct 2027. We can share the Type I report and the control narrative.
> - HIPAA/BAA: MedEx is a business associate for some customers; yes, we will need a BAA in place for PHI flows.
> - Residency: US-only for PHI (us-east-1). Non-PHI analytics data may be processed in us-west-2 for cost reasons, but PHI is restricted.
> - Questionnaire: for initial integration we'd prefer SIG-Lite — we can expand to CAIQ for enterprise contracts later.
>
> Attached a short audit summary that should help Monica map controls to the SIG items.
>
> Questions for you: can you confirm Redwood's default token retention policy for streaming inference? We need clarity on short-lived KV cache, and whether we can request per-customer retention overrides. Also please confirm encryption-at-rest details and if you support customer-managed KMS.
>
> Attaching: [Attachment: MedEx_Audit_Summary.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)]
>
> Happy to provide our compliance portal access if that helps.
>
> Best,
> Karen Liu
> Director, Product Security | MedEx Labs
> karen.liu@medexlabs.com
